package.name: nuxeo-agentic-capture
package.title: Nuxeo Satori capture: incoming files classified, extracted, matched and filed on their record

description.p: Capture and classification's server add-on. A file uploaded into an inbox, a folder of a type a capture profile names, as a document whose type carries the CaptureItem facet, is classified and its fields extracted, in the background, through the capture provider the server configures; then matched to an existing record by the profile's keys, such as a claim number, and filed on it as an attachment, audited, with the classification and its confidence kept on the item.

Anything below the profile's threshold, unmatched, or matching more than one record waits for a person, who confirms, corrects or rejects it. Nothing is filed by itself on a guess below the threshold, and a person files only on a record they may write.

Two providers: a deterministic stand-in, for demonstrations, which reads the file's own text and calls nothing; and one that calls the AI package's AI.* operations, unused until a server setting turns it on, which is to be done only once the AI data terms are approved. It adds no Automation operation.
